copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 它把 Discord 机器人通道接进 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册、安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0、构建并跑注册测试、存入凭证后重启服务。完成后你可以在 Discord 私信或服务器频道里和它对话。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Discord 机器人通道接入 NanoClaw,或在 /setup 流程中需要添加该通道时,它会接管并执行 Apply 各步骤,最后重启服务。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人通道加到 NanoClaw 里。
say.note: 它会复制并注册适配器、安装依赖。

say.text: Discord 机器人收不到我的消息,帮我排查一下。
帮我重新跑一遍 Discord 通道的注册测试。

howto.what_en: Adds the Discord bot channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the package, builds, runs the registration test, stores credentials and restarts. Chat then works via DMs or server channels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, or when the /setup flow reaches adding that channel; it then runs the Apply steps and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel to NanoClaw for me.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs the package.

say_en.text: The Discord bot is online but never sees my messages.
say_en.note: Checks Message Content Intent and shared servers.

say_en.text: Re-run the Discord channel registration test.
